activities.main_competence: 1. Demonstrate mastery of some advanced concepts in Mathematics
activities.specific_competence: 1.1 Demonstrate an advanced understanding of knowledge and skills in Mathematics
activities.learning_activity: (a) Explore advanced tenets of functions (polynomials, rational, composite, exponential, and logarithmic)
suggested_methods: Exploration: Individually or in groups, allow students to explore tenets of functions through function simulations, relevant books and through series of discussions and sharing of findings
activities.assessment_criteria: Advanced tenets of functions are adequately explored

activities.main_competence: 1. Demonstrate mastery of some advanced concepts in Mathematics
activities.specific_competence: 1.1 Demonstrate an advanced understanding of knowledge and skills in Mathematics
activities.learning_activity: (b) Explore advanced tenets of linear programming (transportation: two sources and two destinations,
suggested_methods: Group discussion: In groups, students discuss how to formulate transportation problems and transform into a mathematical model (two sources and two destinations, two sources and three destinations)
Skills lab: In groups, allow students to explore various steps of determining solutions for transportation problems graphically
activities.assessment_criteria: Advanced tenets of linear programming are properly explored

activities.main_competence: 1. Demonstrate mastery of some advanced concepts in Mathematics
activities.specific_competence: 1.1 Demonstrate an advanced understanding of knowledge and skills in Mathematics
activities.learning_activity: (c) Explore advanced tenets of coordinate geometry (angle between two lines, perpendicular distance, locus of a moving point, ratio theorem, and equations of a circle)
suggested_methods: Scenario: Guide students to formulate a scenario which lead them to investigate the angle between two lines
Group discussion: In groups, the students discuss how to find perpendicular distance and locus of a moving point
Snow-balling: In groups, students discuss how to find equations of a circle and how to use the ratio theorem
activities.assessment_criteria: Advanced tenets of coordinate geometry are clearly explored

activities.main_competence: 1. Demonstrate mastery of some advanced concepts in Mathematics
activities.specific_competence: 1.1 Demonstrate an advanced understanding of knowledge and skills in Mathematics
activities.learning_activity: (d) Explore advanced tenets of trigonometry (ratios, small angles, compound angles and factor formulae, trigonometric functions, trigonometric equations, inverse trigonometric functions, graphs of inverse trigonometric functions, domain, and range)
suggested_methods: Scenario: Formulate a scenario which lead students to explore various ratios of trigonometry
Case study: Formulate a case study and through it guide students to approximate small angles, derive and apply compound angles formulae
Gallery walk: In groups, students discuss how to derive and apply factor formulae. Allow each group to post their findings and other groups walk through, note and discuss in the class
Think-Ink-Pair-Share: Allow students to discuss the concept of trigonometric functions, trigonometric equations and inverse trigonometric functions
Skills Lab: In groups, students discuss how to draw the graphs of inverse trigonometric functions and identify domain and range
activities.assessment_criteria: Advanced tenets of trigonometry are adequately explored

activities.main_competence: 1. Demonstrate mastery of some advanced concepts in Mathematics
activities.specific_competence: 1.2 Demonstrate basic understanding of calculus
activities.learning_activity: (a) Explore basic tenets of differentiation (first principles, power rule, chain rule, product rule, quotient rule, and partial derivatives)
suggested_methods: Scenario: Provide scenario which lead students to derive and apply the first principles
Exploration: In groups, students discuss and explore application of power and chain rules
Group discussion: In groups, the students discuss how to derive and apply product and quotient rules
Jigsaw: Guide students through jigsaw, to find partial derivatives of functions
activities.assessment_criteria: Basic tenets of differentiation are properly explored

activities.main_competence: 1. Demonstrate mastery of some advanced concepts in Mathematics
activities.specific_competence: 1.2 Demonstrate basic understanding of calculus
activities.learning_activity: (b) Determine the nature of stationary points, rates of change between quantities, small changes in quantities, and series expansions of different functions
suggested_methods: Scenario: Through relevant scenarios guide students to determine the nature of stationary points
Project: In groups, students visit nearby water dam reservoirs and search for information on the rates of change between quantities and small changes in quantities
Gallery walk: In groups, students discuss how to derive and apply series expansions of different functions and results around the classroom
activities.assessment_criteria: The nature of stationary points, rates of change between quantities, small changes in quantities, and series expansions of different functions are properly determined

activities.main_competence: 1. Demonstrate mastery of some advanced concepts in Mathematics
activities.specific_competence: 1.2 Demonstrate basic understanding of calculus
activities.learning_activity: (c) Explore basic tenets of integration (by parts, substitution method, and partial fractions)
suggested_methods: Skills lab: In groups, students discuss how to derive and apply integration by parts
Role play and Simulation: Guide students to explore various substitution methods in integrating functions
Think-Ink-Pair-Share: In groups, students discuss how to integrate functions which involves partial fractions
activities.assessment_criteria: Basic tenets of integration are adequately explored

activities.main_competence: 1. Demonstrate mastery of some advanced concepts in Mathematics
activities.specific_competence: 1.2 Demonstrate basic understanding of calculus
activities.learning_activity: (d) Determine the area enclosed by a curve, volume of a solid of revolution, and length of an arc
suggested_methods: Jigsaw: Guide students through jigsaw, to determine the area enclosed by a curve and volume of a solid of revolution
Group discussion: In groups, students discuss how to find the length of an arc
activities.assessment_criteria: The area enclosed by a curve, volume of a solid of revolution, and length of an arc are properly determined

activities.main_competence: 2. Demonstrate mastery of set theory and logic
activities.specific_competence: 2.1 Demonstrate an advanced understanding of set theory and logic
activities.learning_activity: (a) Explore advanced tenets of set theory (operations, expressions, and cardinality)
suggested_methods: Brainstorming: Guide students to brainstorm basic operations of sets
Snow-balling: In groups, students discuss how to simplify set expressions and determine cardinality of sets
activities.assessment_criteria: Advanced tenets of set theory are adequately explored

activities.main_competence: 2. Demonstrate mastery of set theory and logic
activities.specific_competence: 2.1 Demonstrate an advanced understanding of set theory and logic
activities.learning_activity: (b) Use knowledge of sets to organise, create, and categorise objects
suggested_methods: Field trip: In groups, students visit nearby real environments and search for different categories of objects
Group discussion: In groups, students discuss how to use knowledge of sets to organise, create, and categorise objects
activities.assessment_criteria: The knowledge of sets to organise, create, and categorise objects is properly used

activities.main_competence: 2. Demonstrate mastery of set theory and logic
activities.specific_competence: 2.1 Demonstrate an advanced understanding of set theory and logic
activities.learning_activity: (c) Explore basic tenets of logic (connectives, propositions, arguments, and electrical networks)
suggested_methods: Think-Ink-Pair-Share: In groups, students discuss logical connectives, and laws of algebra of propositions
Brainstorming: Guide students to brainstorm the meaning of arguments and electrical network
activities.assessment_criteria: Basic tenets of logic are adequately explored

activities.main_competence: 2. Demonstrate mastery of set theory and logic
activities.specific_competence: 2.1 Demonstrate an advanced understanding of set theory and logic
activities.learning_activity: (d) Use logic to analyse arguments and construct circuit diagrams
suggested_methods: Group discussion: In groups, students discuss how to analyse arguments and construct circuit diagrams
activities.assessment_criteria: Arguments and circuit diagrams in logic are analysed adequately

activities.main_competence: 3. Demonstrate mastery of advanced algebra
activities.specific_competence: 3.1 Demonstrate an advanced understanding of algebra
activities.learning_activity: Explore advanced tenets of algebra (series of squares and cubes of natural numbers, roots, quadratic and rational inequalities, 3x3 matrices, partial fractions, mathematical induction, and binomial theorem)
suggested_methods: Think-Ink-Pair-Share: In groups, students discuss how to formulate the series of squares and cubes of natural numbers
Jigsaw: Guide students through jigsaw, to discuss roots of polynomial functions, solution of quadratic and rational inequalities
Group discussion: In groups, students discuss 3x3 matrices, partial fractions, proof by mathematical induction, and binomial theorem and expansion
activities.assessment_criteria: Advanced tenets of algebra are properly explored

activities.main_competence: 4. Conduct a project in Mathematics
activities.specific_competence: 4.1 Carry out a project in Mathematics
activities.learning_activity: Carry out a project to solve a problem using mathematical skills
suggested_methods: Project: In groups, students design and carry out a project to solve a problem using mathematical skills
activities.assessment_criteria: A project has been carried out by using various mathematical knowledge and skills

activities.main_competence: 1. Demonstrate mastery of some advanced concepts in Mathematics
activities.specific_competence: 1.1 Demonstrate an advanced understanding of knowledge and skills in Mathematics
activities.learning_activity: (a) Explore the basic tenets of hyperbolic functions (definition, conversion into logarithmic form, series of hyperbolic cosine and sine functions, derivatives and integration)
suggested_methods: Think-Ink-Pair-Share: In groups, students define hyperbolic functions and convert hyperbolic functions into logarithmic form

Group discussion: In groups, students discuss the series of expansion of hyperbolic cosine and sine functions, derivatives and integration. Allow some groups to present their findings to other students
activities.assessment_criteria: Basic tenets of hyperbolic functions are adequately explored

activities.main_competence: 1. Demonstrate mastery of some advanced concepts in Mathematics
activities.specific_competence: 1.1 Demonstrate an advanced understanding of knowledge and skills in Mathematics
activities.learning_activity: (b) Explore the basic tenets of probability theory (counting principles, independent and dependent events, probability distributions)
suggested_methods: Think-Ink-Pair-Share: In groups, students discuss the concepts of counting principles, independent events, and dependent events
Jigsaw: Guide students through jigsaw, to discuss the concept of probability distributions. Ask them to present their findings
activities.assessment_criteria: The principles, axioms, theorems, and concepts of probability are properly explained

activities.main_competence: 1. Demonstrate mastery of some advanced concepts in Mathematics
activities.specific_competence: 1.1 Demonstrate an advanced understanding of knowledge and skills in Mathematics
activities.learning_activity: (c) Determine the probability of an event, expectation, variance, and standard deviation of random variables
suggested_methods: Group discussion: In groups, students discuss the concepts of probability of an event, expectation, variance, and standard deviation
of random variables. Let students present their findings in the whole class for more inputs
activities.assessment_criteria: The probability of an event, expectation, variance, and standard deviation of random variables are clearly determined

activities.main_competence: 1. Demonstrate mastery of some advanced concepts in Mathematics
activities.specific_competence: 1.1 Demonstrate an advanced understanding of knowledge and skills in Mathematics
activities.learning_activity: (d) Explore the basic tenets of first and second order differential equations (linearity, degree, order, formulation, solutions, homogeneity, separability, and exactness)
suggested_methods: Think-Ink-Pair-Share: In groups, students discuss the linearity, degree, order, and formulation of differential equations
Snow-balling: In groups, students to discuss how to determine the solutions, linearity, homogeneity, separability, and exactness of differential equations
activities.assessment_criteria: Basic tenets of first and second order differential equations are properly explored

activities.main_competence: 1. Demonstrate mastery of some advanced concepts in Mathematics
activities.specific_competence: 1.1 Demonstrate an advanced understanding of knowledge and skills in Mathematics
activities.learning_activity: (e) Use differential equations to solve real life problems related to growth (decay, cooling of bodies, falling bodies, electrical circuits, and vibrating springs)
suggested_methods: Group discussion: In groups, students discuss how to solve problems related to growth, decay, cooling of bodies, falling bodies, electrical circuits, and vibrating springs. Allow some groups to presents in the class for more inputs
activities.assessment_criteria: Problems related to growth, decay, cooling of bodies, falling bodies, electrical circuits, and vibrating springs are adequately solved using differential equations

activities.main_competence: 1. Demonstrate mastery of some advanced concepts in Mathematics
activities.specific_competence: 1.1 Demonstrate an advanced understanding of knowledge and skills in Mathematics
activities.learning_activity: (f) Explore the basic tenets of numerical methods (errors, secant method, Newton-Raphson method, trapezoidal rule, and Simpson’ s rule)
suggested_methods: Skills lab
In groups, students discuss the concepts of errors, secant method, and Newton-Raphson method
Group discussion: In groups, students discuss on how to derive and apply trapezoidal rule and Simpson’s rule to evaluate definite integrals
activities.assessment_criteria: Basic tenets of numerical methods are properly explored

activities.main_competence: 1. Demonstrate mastery of some advanced concepts in Mathematics
activities.specific_competence: 1.1 Demonstrate an advanced understanding of knowledge and skills in Mathematics
activities.learning_activity: (g) Explore advanced tenets of coordinate geometry (parabola, ellipse, hyperbola, and polar coordinates)
suggested_methods: Group discussion: In groups, students discuss and present the concepts of parabola, ellipse, and hyperbola
Gallery walk: In groups, students discuss how to convert polar equations and draw graphs of polar coordinates. Ask students to display their findings for others to view and comment
ICT based learning: In groups, students discuss how to draw graphs of polar coordinates using software
activities.assessment_criteria: Advanced tenets of coordinate geometry are adequately explored

activities.main_competence: 1. Demonstrate mastery of some advanced concepts in Mathematics
activities.specific_competence: 1.1 Demonstrate an advanced understanding of knowledge and skills in Mathematics
activities.learning_activity: (h) Explore advanced tenets of vectors (ratio theorems, dot product, cross product, vector differentiation, and vector integration)
suggested_methods: Think-Ink-Pair-Share: In manageable groups, students discuss ratio theorems, dot product, and cross product
Group discussion: In manageable groups, students discuss on how to differentiate and integrate vector functions
activities.assessment_criteria: Advanced tenets of vectors are clearly explored

activities.main_competence: 1. Demonstrate mastery of some advanced concepts in Mathematics
activities.specific_competence: 1.1 Demonstrate an advanced understanding of knowledge and skills in Mathematics
activities.learning_activity: (i) Use vectors to solve problems related to displacement, velocity, and acceleration of a particle, work done by forces, and projection of vectors
suggested_methods: Group discussion: In manageable groups, students discuss and present how to solve problems related to displacement, velocity, and acceleration of a particle, work done by forces, and projection of vectors
activities.assessment_criteria: Problems related to displacement, velocity, and acceleration of a particle, work done by forces, and projection of vectors are solved using vectors

activities.main_competence: 1. Demonstrate mastery of some advanced concepts in Mathematics
activities.specific_competence: 1.1 Demonstrate an advanced understanding of knowledge and skills in Mathematics
activities.learning_activity: (j) Explore the basic tenets of complex numbers (modulus, argument, Argand diagram, polar form, De Moivre’ s theorem and Euler’s formula)
suggested_methods: Gallery walk: In groups, students discuss and display how to find modulus and argument of complex numbers and draw graphs on the Argand diagram
Group discussion: In groups, students discuss concepts of polar form, De Moivre’s theorem, and Euler’s formula
activities.assessment_criteria: Basic tenets of complex numbers are clearly explored

activities.main_competence: 1. Demonstrate mastery of some advanced concepts in Mathematics
activities.specific_competence: 1.2 Demonstrate an advanced understanding of statistics
activities.learning_activity: Explore advanced tenets of statistics (measures of central tendency and dispersion: mean, variance and standard deviation by coding method, quartiles, and percentiles)
suggested_methods: Skills lab
In groups, students discuss how to find the measures of central tendency and dispersion, mean, variance and standard deviation by coding method
Think-Ink-Pair-Share: In groups, students discuss how to determine the quartiles and percentiles of the grouped data
activities.assessment_criteria: Advanced tenets of statistics are adequately explored

activities.main_competence: 2. Conduct a project in Mathematics
activities.specific_competence: 2.1 Carry out a project in Mathematics
activities.learning_activity: Complete the project started in Form Five and submit the report for assessment
suggested_methods: Project: In groups, students complete the project started in Form Five and submit the report
activities.assessment_criteria: Project is completed according to the criteria and the report is submitted
